title: Mild hybrid setup and drivability
summary: Feedback on the mild hybrid setup centers on improved smoothness, acceleration, and fuel economy, with a few complaints about awkward tuning and poor integration with the engine, while many fragments mention the system without a clearly classifiable sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the mild hybrid for pleasant support, smoother driving, stronger acceleration, and an overall excellent setup.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on awkward throttle calibration and poor coordination between the hybrid system and engine.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention fuel economy gains, subtle operation, and general improvement from the mild hybrid system, but the sampled examples are insufficient to assign a clear overall sentiment to those mentions.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are tagged undetermined, which limits how confidently the sentiment of the topic can be characterized from examples alone.
The available examples are concentrated on general mild-hybrid benefits and integration issues, so they may not capture the full range of owner feedback on this topic.
Samples are sentiment-stratified and not representative estimates of the full review population.
